results.title: 1971 Triumph Blazer 250 SS at No Reserve
results.description: This 1971 Triumph Blazer 250 SS was acquired by the seller's father in 2021, and ownership later passed to the seller. The bike is finished in orange with black accents and powered by a 247cc four-stroke single mated to a four-speed gearbox with right-side shifting. Details include a two-up vinyl seat, a kick starter, an Amal carburetor, an upswept exhaust system, oil-in-frame lubrication, a grab handle, a chrome handlebar, a skid plate, a Smiths speedometer, street lighting, and 18" wire-spoke wheels. This Blazer 250 SS is now offered at no reserve with a Minnesota title in the seller's name.
